items.exampleEn: Environmental groups planted trees along the river.
items.exampleZh: 環保團體沿著河邊種樹。

items.exampleEn: The plane needs a lot of fuel for long flights.
items.exampleZh: 飛機長途飛行需要大量燃料。

items.exampleEn: The guide warned us about the snakes.
items.exampleZh: 導遊警告我們要小心蛇。

items.exampleEn: The teacher gave us a warning: no phones in class.
items.exampleZh: 老師給了我們一個警告：上課不准用手機。

items.exampleEn: The museum preserves old letters and maps.
items.exampleZh: 博物館收藏著古老的信件和地圖。

items.exampleEn: The little bird's survival was a surprise to everyone.
items.exampleZh: 那隻小鳥能活下來，讓大家都很驚訝。

items.exampleEn: This machine uses very little electricity.

items.sentenceEn: Turn off the lights to save electricity.

items.audioEn: There will be no electricity from nine to noon tomorrow, so please charge your phones tonight.
items.audioZh: 明天九點到中午會停電，所以請今晚幫手機充電。
items.questionZh: 為什麼要今晚幫手機充電？
options: The power will be off tomorrow.

items.sentenceEn: The radio gave a storm warning this morning.
items.sentenceZh: 今天早上廣播發布了暴風雨警告。

items.sentenceEn: Volunteers work hard to preserve the forest.

items.stemEn: Plastic waste is a serious ____ problem.
items.stemZh: 塑膠垃圾是嚴重的環境問題。

items.stemEn: Our car is low on ____, so we must stop at a gas station.
items.stemZh: 我們的車快沒油了，所以得在加油站停一下。

items.passageEn: Our town held an environmental fair last Saturday. At one table, a scientist explained that some fish can't reproduce when the river water is dirty. She warned us that their survival depends on a clean habitat. At another table, students showed how to make electricity from the wind and the sun. A local bus company showed its new buses, which use a cleaner fuel. There was also a talk about how to preserve the old trees in the town park. At the entrance, a sign gave a short warning: "Please take your trash home."
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上上週六辦了一場環保博覽會。在一張桌子前，一位科學家解釋說河水髒的時候，有些魚就無法繁殖。她警告我們，牠們的存活取決於乾淨的棲息地。另一張桌子前，學生們示範怎麼用風和陽光發電。一家本地公車公司展示了使用較乾淨燃料的新公車。還有一場講座談怎麼保護鎮上公園裡的老樹。入口處有個告示寫著簡短的警告：「請把垃圾帶回家。」

questions.questionZh: 科學家說河水髒的時候魚會怎樣？
入口處的告示寫了什麼？

items.promptZh: 媽媽警告我不要靠近河邊。
referenceEn: My mother warned me not to go near the river.
My mom warned me to stay away from the river.
rubricZh: warn 表示「警告」，例如 warn someone not to… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 survival 造一個句子，說說你覺得生存最需要什麼。
referenceEn: I think water is the most important thing for survival.
For survival in the jungle, I would need a knife.
rubricZh: survival 表示「生存、存活」，是不可數名詞，例如 for survival 等說法
說的是自己的看法（例如 I think）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式或 would 等）
